items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I guess I was with Tony[Fambreau's]band about three years or so, you know.

ctx.x: In -- about Tony[Fambreau's]band, how long did it last? How many years did he have a band?
Let me see. Now, John Levy probably would know this, because John was playing bass with it. I guess I was with Tony[Fambreau's]band about three years or so, you know.
Was the band around quite a long time in Chicago?
